result: For a wide two-layer ReLU net, GD’s residual follows (I − ηH∞)ᵏy, so labels aligned with the top eigenvectors of the kernel H∞ are learned fast and random labels slowly; and the width-independent quantity √(2yᵀ(H∞)⁻¹y/n) bounds the generalization error.
result_plain: Fine-grained NTK analysis: per-eigendirection convergence explains true vs random label speed; y^T H^-1 y bounds generalization.
